gabriella olivo.bio: Quebec City-born, Montreal-based singer-songwriter Gabriella Olivo blends her Mexican and Québécois roots through French- and Spanish-language Latin electro-pop. Drawing on bolero, cumbia, indie music and cinematic textures, she has earned recognition including a 2025-26 Radio-Canada Révélation nod and ADISQ and GAMIQ nominations for her bilingual work.

simar.bio: Toronto-born and raised singer, songwriter and composer Simar is a Canadian Punjabi artist blending hip-hop, R&B and pop with Punjabi-language songwriting. She has collaborated with artists including Sidhu Moosewala, Fateh and Talwiinder while building a bilingual catalogue that places a female perspective at the centre of contemporary Punjabi music.

tallulah argue.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Tallulah Argue is a Canadian artist whose music combines country, alternative pop and grungy Americana with witty, narrative-driven writing. After beginning her career in Toronto, she relocated to London to study and develop her work, releasing songs including Moonshine and the 2026 EP Deer in the Headlights.

trobiz.bio: Halifax hip-hop artist, producer and entrepreneur Tremayne 'Trobiz' Howe has been part of Nova Scotia's rap community since the early 1990s. A member of the early group The Overlords, he later became known for production work with artists including JRDN and Classified while also operating Fademasters in Halifax's North End.

ryael.bio: Ryael is the stage name of East Toronto-born R&B singer Isrrael, a Canadian artist whose music blends contemporary soul, R&B and melodic pop. Raised in a musical family, he has built an independent catalogue including Lover's Prayer, Midnight Confession and Changes while performing across Toronto's live R&B circuit.
